user.t:
On C:\Users\mariu\ventures\subrogation-recovery, refresh the Norwegian (.no.md) documentation so it matches the CURRENT English docs. English stays the source of truth.

1. For each existing .no.md (ARCHITECTURE.no.md, README.no.md, business/README.no.md, business/business-plan.no.md, business/market-analysis.no.md, deploy/aws.no.md, financial/README.no.md, financial/model.no.md, fundraising/README.no.md, hiring/README.no.md, technical/README.no.md, technical/overview.no.md): re-translate from its current English counterpart so it is up to date (the foundation, developer-portal, and SEO/marketing work changed several English docs).
2. Add Norwegian for the NEW marketing doc: marketing/seo-and-growth.no.md. The marketing/landing/ outline and the developer-portal API pages stay ENGLISH — don't translate those; note that choice in the marketing .no.md header.
3. Preserve EVERY honest caveat (pre-product, synthetic data, needs third-party audit/pentest, needs licensed Norwegian advokat, jurisdiction tables illustrative/counsel-unreviewed, no fabricated metrics). Do not add claims absent from the English.
4. Natural Norwegian (bokmål). Keep code blocks, commands, API field names, and key/env identifiers (SR_/srk_) unchanged.

Do NOT touch src/ or any code or tests. Commit in a logical chunk and `git push origin HEAD`. End the commit message with:
Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <[REDACTED:email]>
Return a concise summary.

handback.t:
Four Norwegian docs were refreshed or added and pushed as commit 5d63d93 to origin/master. The other nine .no.md files were not rewritten, because their English sources have not changed since they were translated.

The English files changed since the last Norwegian copies are README.md, ARCHITECTURE.md and deploy/aws.md. I confirmed this with `git diff 5c0e794 HEAD -- '*.md'`. The new marketing doc is the only other change in scope; ops/tooling-stack.md also changed but was not in your list.

**Rewritten from the current English:**
- `README.no.md` covers the production foundation (per-tenant API-key auth, Postgres, bounded parsing, hash-locked supply chain). It also has the new API routes, the `SR_*` configuration table, the "Running with auth + Postgres" section and the six-item "Before real customer data" list. The repository map now lists developer-portal/ and marketing/.
- `ARCHITECTURE.no.md` has the platform request path, the module table and the new key decisions.
- `deploy/aws.no.md` has the feature-to-AWS mapping table and the claimant-data (retention/DPA) section.

**New:**
- `marketing/seo-and-growth.no.md` is a full translation. Its header states that `marketing/landing/` and `developer-portal/` stay English, and the references to them point at the English files.

**Unchanged:** the 9 other .no.md files (business, financial, technical, fundraising, hiring and the small READMEs) already match their English sources. Their Use of Funds sections are already present, and a keyword spot-check of caveat terms found no losses.

All the caveats you listed are preserved. I added no new claims and no metrics. Code blocks, commands, API fields and `SR_`/`srk_` identifiers are unchanged. I touched no src/ files, code or tests.

I dropped one clause from the Norwegian version. The English hreflang bullet says the Norwegian translation of this plan is "pending", which is no longer true, so I removed that clause. The English file still carries the "pending" note, and I did not edit English files.

The untracked `.claude-flow/` directory was left uncommitted.
